issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: MCP Connectors by Databox
products.tagline: Give your AI Analyst context to explain performance and act
products.summaryZh: 为你的AI分析师提供背景信息，以便解释表现并采取行动
products.descriptionZh: 将你的 AI Analyst 连接到业务所依赖的工具。它从你的 CRM 或支持服务台提取上下文，因此每个回答都能反映业务中的实际情况，并能基于发现采取行动。可从 10+ 连接器中选择，或添加任意 MCP 服务器。
products.description: Connect your AI Analyst to the tools your business runs on. It pulls context from your CRM or support desk, so every answer reflects what's happening in your business, and it can act on what it finds. Choose from 10+ connectors or add any MCP server.

products.name: Statable Analytics
products.tagline: Web analytics built for you and your AI agents
products.summaryZh: 为你和你的AI代理构建的网络分析
products.descriptionZh: Statable 是一款为人类和 AI 智能体打造的网页分析工具。你可以自己使用简洁的仪表盘，也可以通过 MCP 连接 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor、Codex 等智能体，读取报告、分析流量，并配置跟踪、目标和漏斗。不使用 Cookie，大多数情况下无需分析同意横幅，数据托管在欧盟。
products.description: Statable is web analytics built for humans and AI agents. Use the simple dashboard yourself, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and other agents through MCP to read reports, analyze traffic, and configure tracking, goals, and funnels. No cookies, no analytics consent banner in most cases, and your data stays hosted in the EU.

products.name: Vitals 
products.tagline: A Mac activity monitor that thinks in apps, not processes
products.summaryZh: 一款以应用而非进程为视角的 Mac 活动监视器
products.descriptionZh: 活动监视器列出上千个进程，其中上百个都叫 Google Chrome Helper。Vitals 把每个辅助进程归入启动它的应用，于是你看到的是 60 个应用，而非 1000 个进程，每个应用只显示内存、CPU、能耗、磁盘和网络的单一数值。它保留 30 天历史记录，在应用行为异常时提醒你，找出被遗忘的开发服务器，并显示温度、风扇和电池状态。每项读数都能按你的方式排列在菜单栏中。一次付费。无订阅，无账户。
products.description: Activity Monitor lists a thousand processes, a hundred of them called Google Chrome Helper. Vitals adds every helper to the app that launched it, so you see 60 apps instead of 1,000 processes, each with one figure for memory, CPU, energy, disk and network. It keeps 30 days of history, alerts you when an app misbehaves, finds forgotten dev servers, and shows temperatures, fans and battery. Every readout can sit in your menu bar, arranged your way. Pay once. No subscription, no account.

products.name: VibeDefend by CybeDefend
products.tagline: The one command line to secure your Cursor and Claude Code
products.summaryZh: 保护你的 Cursor 和 Claude Code 的唯一命令行
products.descriptionZh: VibeDefend 通过一条命令即可安装到你的 AI 编码代理（Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、Copilot、Codex 等）上。此后，代理在编写代码时会遵循从你的代码库中挖掘出的业务规则，并在上下文中纳入你的安全规则。它会在文件仍处于打开状态时扫描每一处差异，守卫会在 rm -rf、sudo 或读取你的密钥等操作运行前予以拒绝。扫描器在提交后检查代码，而它在代码行写入前就已运行。免费方案，无需信用卡。
products.description: VibeDefend installs on your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex and more) with one command. From then on the agent writes with your business rules, mined from your repo, and your security rules in its context. It scans each diff while the file is still open, and a guard refuses rm -rf, sudo or a read of your secrets before it runs. Scanners check code after the commit, this runs before the line is written. Free plan, no card.

products.name: Okara
products.tagline: The world's first AI CMO
products.summaryZh: 全球首位AI首席营销官
products.descriptionZh: Okara 是一位 AI CMO。输入你的网站，它会研究你的产品、竞争对手和品牌语调，然后运行 10 多个代理，负责 SEO、AI 搜索、Reddit、X、LinkedIn、创作者和 UGC 视频。每份草稿都由你批准，然后它负责发布。已有超过 100,000 家企业使用。
products.description: Okara is an AI CMO. Enter your website and it studies your product, competitors and brand voice, then runs 10+ agents for SEO, AI search, Reddit, X, LinkedIn, creators and UGC video. You approve every draft and it publishes. Used by 100,000+ businesses.

products.name: GenCode
products.tagline: A coding agent inside the Genspark Super App
products.summaryZh: Genspark Super App 内置的编码代理
products.descriptionZh: GenCode 是 Genspark 的编码代理，提供聊天和终端界面。它支持来自 Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek 等的模型，并可直接在你选择的目录中处理代码。
products.description: GenCode is Genspark’s coding agent with Chat and Terminal UIs. It supports models from Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more, and works directly on code in a directory you choose.

products.name: Shotcandy
products.tagline: Make Your Screenshots Look Amazing
products.summaryZh: 让你的截图惊艳出众
products.descriptionZh: 粘贴截图，即刻获得精美效果。Shotcandy 是一款免费的截图美化工具，可在浏览器中数秒内将普通截图变成精美、适合分享的图片和视频。
products.description: Paste a screenshot. Get something lovely. Shotcandy is a free screenshot beautifier that turns plain screenshots into beautiful, share-ready images and videos in seconds, right in your browser.

products.name: Dina 4.5
products.tagline: Beautiful screen recordings, screenshots, and 3D motion
products.summaryZh: 精美的屏幕录制、截图和3D动态效果
products.descriptionZh: 录制屏幕，捕捉精美截图，添加电影级3D动态与透视效果，自定义每一处细节，并通过链接即时分享。Dina 4.5将屏幕录制、截图、3D动画和分享功能整合到一个快速且设计精美的工作流程中。
products.description: Record your screen, capture beautiful screenshots, add cinematic 3D motion and perspective, customize every detail, and share instantly with a link. Dina 4.5 brings screen recordings, screenshots, 3D animations, and sharing into one fast, beautifully designed workflow.

products.name: Stash
products.tagline: Hidden controls for your Mac.
products.summaryZh: Mac 的隐藏控制功能。
products.descriptionZh: Stash 为你的 Mac 带来隐藏式控制，仿佛它们一直就该在那里。界面美观、原生感十足，用起来令人无比满足——通过触感滑块和旋钮调节系统控制，管理窗口，并借助隐藏式可展开 Dock 和应用启动器让常用应用触手可及。Stash Deck 将这一体验延伸至 iPhone，把它变成 Mac 的触感遥控器，支持快捷控制、应用启动和可配置小组件。
products.description: Stash gives your Mac hidden controls that feel like they’ve always belonged there. Beautiful, native-feeling and ridiculously satisfying to use - adjust system controls with tactile sliders and dials, manage windows, and keep your favourite apps within reach through a hidden expandable dock and app launcher. Stash Deck extends the experience to your iPhone, turning it into a tactile remote for your Mac with quick controls, app launching and configurable widgets.

products.name: MuM
products.tagline: A reading-first Markdown engine for macOS
products.summaryZh: 面向阅读优先的 macOS Markdown 引擎
products.descriptionZh: 你的 Markdown 散落在十几个文件夹里。大多数时候你并不想写，只想读其中一节。所有 Markdown 工具都是带预览窗格的写作应用。MuM 恰恰相反：一个原生 macOS 阅读器，内部没有网页引擎——全部基于 AppKit。可同时打开多个项目，各自记住你读到哪里。跨项目搜索。排版同时针对中日韩文字和拉丁文字调校。冷启动约 0.3 秒，下载 1.7 MB，滚动 5 MB 文档保持 100+ fps。开源，MIT。
products.description: Your Markdown lives in a dozen folders. Most of the time you don't want to write — you just want to read one section. Every Markdown tool is a writing app with a preview pane. MuM is the opposite: a native macOS reader with no web engine inside — all AppKit. Several projects open at once, each remembering where you stopped. Cross-project search. Typesetting tuned for CJK as well as Latin. ~0.3s cold start, 1.7 MB download, 100+ fps scrolling a 5 MB document. Open source, MIT.

products.name: vantage.ai
products.tagline: See and control what your coding agent does.
products.summaryZh: 查看并控制你的编码代理所做的事。
products.descriptionZh: Vantage 是一款免费、开源的编码代理成本与用量监控、防护及会话日志工具。
products.description: Vantage is a free, open-source cost and usage monitor, guardrail and session log for coding agents.

products.name: Mochi
products.tagline: A cute Mac desktop pet that organizes your loose files
products.summaryZh: 一只可爱的 Mac 桌面宠物，帮你整理散落的文件
products.descriptionZh: Mochi 是一个住在你 Mac 上的粉色小团子。它四处漂浮，打打盹，调侃你又熬夜，还会把散落在桌面上的文件收进文件夹（绝不删除，移动皆可撤销）。Pro 版增加了一个微小的生活模拟：一棵草莓树、一个巢，以及一个需要养育的家庭。
products.description: Mochi is a little pink blob who lives on your Mac. It floats around, naps, teases you about late nights and carries loose Desktop files into folders (never deletes, undo any move). Pro adds a tiny life sim: a strawberry tree, a nest and a family to raise.

products.name: Harness Router
products.tagline: Fast AI tool routing powered by Jev.
products.summaryZh: 由 Jev 驱动的快速 AI 工具路由。
products.descriptionZh: Harness Router 是 AI 编码代理的决策层，让工具选择在执行前更快、更省、更可靠。可将其用作 Codex hook，自动路由每一次工具调用；也可作为 skill，在代理需要显式调用路由时使用。显而易见的决策走快速路径，模糊选择由 Jev 解决，复杂的多步决策可升级至 MCTS。
products.description: Harness Router is a decision layer for AI coding agents that makes tool selection faster, cheaper, and more reliable before execution. Use it as a Codex hook to automatically route every tool call, or as a skill when the agent should invoke routing explicitly. Obvious decisions stay on the fast path, ambiguous choices are resolved with Jev, and complex multi-step decisions can escalate to MCTS.

products.name: Zerg Router
products.tagline: Run DeepSeek in Codex
products.summaryZh: 在Codex中运行DeepSeek
products.descriptionZh: 一个兼容 OpenAI 的端点，服务你所有的编码代理。路由策略存在你的账户里，而不是每个工具内部。• 在 Codex 中运行 DeepSeek 4.1 Flash（或其他模型），保持你的工作流不变 • 为每个 API 密钥设置独立的每日预算，按请求强制执行 • 明确的回退机制：遇到 5xx、429 或超时，自动尝试下一个模型 • 跨多个 Codex 账户查看每周剩余配额和重置日期 支持付费使用，或自带提供商密钥。
products.description: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for all your coding agents. The routing policy lives in your account, not inside each tool. • Run DeepSeek 4.1 Flash (or other models) inside Codex, and keep your workflow • Give every API key its own daily budget, enforced per request • Explicit fallbacks: on a 5xx, 429 or timeout, try your next model • See remaining weekly quota and reset dates across Codex accounts Supports paid usage, or bring your own provider keys.

products.name: Sayble
products.tagline: AI copilot for calls that tells you what to say next
products.summaryZh: 通话AI助手，实时提示下一句该说什么
products.descriptionZh: Sayble 是一款面向销售通话、客户会议和谈判的实时 AI 副驾。它能听到对方刚说的话，并在约半秒内给你一句清晰的下一句应答，外加一句备用话术。通话结束后，它会撰写纪要以及一封可直接发送的跟进邮件。适用于 Zoom、Meet、Teams 和电话通话。支持 Mac 和 Windows，10 种语言。
products.description: Sayble is a real-time AI copilot for sales calls, client meetings and negotiations. It hears what the other person just said and gives you one clear line to say next, plus a backup, in about half a second. When the call ends, it writes the recap and a ready-to-send follow-up email. Works on Zoom, Meet, Teams and phone calls. Mac & Windows, 10 languages.

products.name: Arc
products.tagline: Your mobile AI assistant on any screen
products.summaryZh: 你的移动AI助手，适配任何屏幕
products.descriptionZh: Arc 是一款免费的 AI 助手，可在你当前所在的任何屏幕上使用。无需将文本复制到聊天机器人中。在任何应用上唤起 Arc，它就能为你读取屏幕内容。• 即时总结文章、聊天记录、邮件和文档 • 聆听：让任何屏幕内容朗读出来 • 在你输入的位置直接以恰当的语气改写回复和消息 • 跨应用自动化重复步骤 适用于 Android 和 Mac。免费开始使用。
products.description: Arc is a free AI assistant that works on whatever screen you're already on. You don't have to copy text into a chatbot. Call Arc up over any app and it reads the screen for you. • Summarize articles, chats, emails and docs instantly • Listen: have any screen read aloud • Rewrite replies and messages in the right tone, right where you type • Automate repetitive steps across apps Available on Android and Mac. Free to start.

products.name: SaleSmartly
products.tagline: Turn conversations across every channel into customers
products.summaryZh: 将各个渠道的对话转化为客户
products.descriptionZh: SaleSmartly 将来自 WhatsApp、Instagram、Messenger、TikTok、Telegram、LINE、WeChat 等的客户对话汇集到一个工作区。通过内置 CRM 管理潜在客户，让 AI 代理全天候解答问题并筛选客户，实时翻译对话，自动跟进——同时团队保留必要的上下文，将更多对话转化为客户。
products.description: SaleSmartly brings customer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, Telegram, LINE, WeChat and more into one workspace. Manage leads with a built-in CRM, let AI agents answer questions and qualify customers 24/7, translate conversations in real time, and automate follow-ups—all while your team keeps the context needed to turn more conversations into customers.

products.name: Microsoft Copilot
products.tagline: The Al built for work
products.summaryZh: 为工作打造的人工智能
products.descriptionZh: 全新 Copilot 将人们依赖的工具与下一代能力连接起来，助其在工作中构建、定制和扩展 AI。Copilot 连接你的工作内容和你已在使用的应用，汇聚最新 AI 模型，帮你完成最终成果，而不仅仅是给出答案。
products.description: The new Copilot connects the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI across work. Copilot connects with your work content and the apps you already use, bringing together the latest AI models to help you create finished work, not just answers.

products.name: Ryu Journal
products.tagline: A journal to help busy minds let go
products.summaryZh: 一本帮助忙碌心灵放下的手账
products.descriptionZh: Ryu在日语中意为“流”。这就是全部理念。Ryu Journal是一个安静的地方，让你放下一个念头，然后让它流走。没有账户，没有社交动态，没有压力——只有你和页面。打开它，写下心中所想，然后回到你的一天。写下，然后放下。一个干净、无干扰的编辑器。点击加号，书写，保存。点击任何条目继续书写。你的一周轻轻汇聚成一条简单的时间线。
products.description: Ryu means "flow" in Japanese. That's the whole idea. Ryu Journal is a quiet place to put a thought down and let it go. No accounts, no social feed, no pressure — just you and the page. Open it, write what's on your mind, and get back to your day. WRITE, THEN LET GO A clean, distraction-free editor. Tap the plus, write, save. Tap any entry to keep writing. Your week gathers softly into one simple timeline.

products.name: Lattice
products.tagline: Reshape your text across languages while preserving meaning
products.summaryZh: 在不同语言间重塑你的文本，同时保留原意
products.descriptionZh: Lattice通过多种语言路径重塑你的文本，在保留原意的基础上创造出全新的表达。
products.description: Lattice reshapes your text through multiple language paths, creating a fresh expression while preserving the original idea.
